text.en: Pet owners express deep appreciation for the reliable and accommodating care provided by Jenni and her team. Reviewers emphasize their punctuality, scheduling flexibility during demanding work weeks, and dedicated support for dogs requiring steady neighborhood routines.

Clients highlight the team's ability to handle reactive, anxious, and leash-sensitive dogs with patience and expertise. Pet parents note that their dogs quickly warm up to the walkers and return from each neighborhood stroll visibly calm, happy, and well exercised.

Reviewers frequently commend the thorough communication provided after each scheduled outing. Pet parents appreciate receiving dozens of photographs per session alongside GPS route confirmations and helpful notes regarding their pet's temperament and energy level.

q.en: What services does Peoples N Puppers offer in Philadelphia?

a.en: The team provides thirty- and forty-five-minute neighborhood dog walks, in-home pet sitting drop-ins, and personalized boarding support.

q.en: How does the team handle reactive or anxious dogs?

a.en: Walkers have experience managing leash reactivity and anxious behaviours, using calm, positive techniques to keep pets secure and relaxed.

q.en: What updates do pet parents receive during walks?

a.en: Clients receive detailed digital visit reports after each session, complete with numerous photos, route tracking, and behavioural summaries.

q.en: Are frequent walker discounts available for regular clients?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that discounted package arrangements are offered for pet owners who schedule recurring weekly walking services.
